articles.title: A Stinky Surprise: 800-Year-Old Latrine Yields a Wax Notebook and Silk Toilet Paper
articles.summary: Archaeologists in Paderborn, Germany, uncovered a medieval merchant’s wax notebook in an 800-year-old latrine, still reeking after centuries. The leather-bound book, covered in cryptic cursive Latin, was found alongside silk fabric likely used as toilet paper. High-tech imaging may soon unlock its secrets.

articles.title: Madonna Covers Rent for Tenants of Iconic NYC Rehearsal Space: ‘A Much-Needed Lifeline’
articles.summary: Madonna surprised musicians at New York’s historic Music Building by paying up to $1,999.99 of their May rent, partnering with Bilt. The gesture targeted the Midtown Manhattan space where she once rehearsed, offering crucial support to about 100 bands. Tenants called it an ‘amazing show of support’ amid tough times.

articles.title: Young MC Says Freedom 250 Gig Was a ‘Bait-and-Switch’: ‘I Had No Clue It Was Trump-Backed’
articles.summary: Rapper Young MC dropped out of Washington D.C.’s Freedom 250 concert after learning of its ties to the Trump administration, calling the booking a ‘bait-and-switch.’ He and other ’90s acts were blindsided by the political affiliation, sparking swift backlash. Young MC says he was never given a choice about the event’s partisan nature.
